title: Application of Commonwealth Electric Company, under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, § 94G, as amended by St. 1981 c. 375, and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. No. 98, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the quarterly power cost charge to be billed to the Company customers pursuant to meter readings in the billing months of October, November and December, 1986. Application is also made by Commonwealth Electric Company for approval by the Department of rates to be to Qualifying Facilities for purchases of power pursuant to 220 C.M.R. 8.00 and M.D.P.U. 106. The rules established in 220 C.M.R. 8.00 set forth the filings to be made by utilities with the Department and, implement the intent of sec. 201 and 210 of the Public Utility Regulatory Policies Act of 1978.
